description.text: Ten single attacks (0.63 each), grants [Attach Water], [High Quick Cast 1], [Dim Spray Follow-Up] and [Pirate's Geyser] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Dim Spray Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Dim Spray after using a Water ability

description.name: Pirate's Geyser
description.text: Grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row after using a Water ability
